P.C.: 
1. Heard Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicannt and Mrs. Poonam Bhosale,
learned App for the Respondent- State.

2. By the present Application, the Applicant herein / accused seeking to quash & set quash the FIR in Crime No.273 of2020 registered Kandivali Police Station, Mumbai (now transferred to Crime Branch Uni-11 Mumbai Division, Kandivali (West) as Crime No.92 of 2020) for the offence punishable under section 420, 328, 279, 273, 179, 188, 120B of I.P.C. and section: 26(2) (1), 27(2)4,
27(3), 3(1)(z)(3), 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act dated 11 th May 2020 with 2, 3, 4, of the Epidemic Act, 1897 with Charge sheet dated 27th July, 2021 and Case Sharada 2-APL-542-2026.doc bearing Sessions Case No.100947 of 2021 pending before the Ld. City Civil and Sessions Court Mumbai.
3. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

He further Musahid Ahmed Masgul Ahmad Shaikh vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159446473/
1 submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos.280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.

sentences.text: He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs.

4. Mrs. Poonam Bhosale, learned APP for the Respondent-State does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Application is subject matter of the Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Application.

She submits that the present Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sannhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions and other connected matters.
5. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid Petitions, be also granted in this Application.
6. Mrs. Poonam Bhosale, learned APP for the Respondent-State does not object to the said request.
Sharada 2-APL-542-2026.doc 7.
In view of the above, further proceedings in a Case bearing Sessions Case No.100947 of 2021 pending before the Learned City Civil and Sessions Court Mumbai are stayed qua the Applicant.
8. Tag this Application along with Criminal Writ Petition No.280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025, and 4078 of 2025.
